name: ruvector
description: High-performance vector database ecosystem with 45+ npm packages and RVF (RuVector Format) cognitive containers: single-file deployment primitive that replaces vector DBs, model registries, container images, graph stores, and audit logs. HNSW indexing (50k+ inserts/sec), GNN knowledge graphs, self-learning hooks (Q-learning, semantic memory), multi-provider LLM orchestration with SONA/LoRA/EWC++, FastGRNN neural routing (10us), 39 attention mechanisms, distributed Raft consensus, edge/WASM runtimes, neuromorphic computing (spiking nets, HDC, BTSP), multi-agent coordination with CRDT economy, PostgreSQL vector extension, and self-booting cognitive containers with witness chains.
